name: location-toast-simple
description: Completing the location prompt via geolocation fires a success toast carrying the parsed location.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: stub-geolocation-and-reverse-geocode
steps.eval: (() => { Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'geolocation', { value: { getCurrentPosition: (ok) => ok({ coords: { latitude: 1.3521, longitude: 103.8198 } }) }, configurable: true }); const realFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url; if (url.includes('nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse')) { return new Response(JSON.stringify({ display_name: 'Singapore' }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); } return realFetch(input, init); }; })()
